method: Each provisional statement was reread with its complete source paragraph/table/list context in the pinned VCFv4.5.tex file. Review checked actor/referent, conditions, normative force, one-behavior atomicity, source line accuracy, descriptive versus normative content, repeated clauses and source ambiguities. This is an author-level review; no independent approval is claimed.
limitations: The source text itself contains unresolved internal inconsistencies documented in the ambiguity artifact.
Some descriptive/definition records are supporting semantic evidence, not standalone file-validation MUST rules.
A single computed END maximum is retained as one aggregate rule because the three endpoints jointly define the maximum operation.
The review does not establish VCFv4.1–4.4 or VCFv4.0 applicability.
